residual_findings.title: React Router: open redirect via backslash in <Link> and useNavigate (CVE-2025-68470 bypass)
residual_findings.reason: Requires an attacker-controlled string with a leading backslash to reach a <Link to> or navigate() target. Every dynamic target in frontend/src is either a path this application wrote into history state (checked for the /account/ prefix before use), a value from a fixed set returned by destinationForSession(), or a report/dashboard link built server-side in report_service.py as a literal '/...' path with enum values in the query string. No URL query parameter, form field or API string is ever passed to a navigation.

residual_findings.title: React Router: arbitrary constructor injection via deserializeErrors() in SSR hydration
residual_findings.reason: Requires server-side rendering with a data router and hydrateRoot. main.jsx uses createRoot; there is no StaticRouter, createBrowserRouter, RouterProvider or hydrateRoot anywhere in frontend/src.

unresolved_launch_blockers: OD-34 - no production email provider is selected; data residency, an authenticated sending domain, and bounce and complaint handling are all unaddressed. Customer Account registration cannot launch in production.
OD-37 - no approved terms or privacy text exists. Both versions are placeholders that name themselves as placeholders, and production registration refuses while either is one.
OD-39 - the customer-facing English copy has not been reviewed. REVIEW_customer_account_copy.md is written and blank.
OD-19 - no accessibility reviewer is assigned. 125 automated audits are not a human review.
OD-01 / OD-36 - retention periods are undecided, so no canonical deletion schedule exists.
DEC-0006 - rate limiting is in-process and per-worker. More than one worker needs a shared store.
OD-17 - staff MFA is undecided. OD-33 defers customer MFA separately.
Secrets are not in a secret store; credential_ref must name an entry, never a value.
Provider integration remains deferred (DEC-0075). No adapter, no allowlisted host, no webhook.

known_risks_at_freeze: The booking reference is shown on the list row but not on the shipment detail, which stays at parity with Public Tracking (24 fields) (DEC-0160; PROJECT_STATUS.md section 42.4 point 1).
The package search includes cancelled packages, as the detail shows them (DEC-0161; section 42.4 point 2).
The postal code has no format check at all, only the 30-character bound (DEC-0159; section 42.4 point 3).
The API's billing_same_as_shipping still defaults to false; only the form starts ticked (DEC-0158; section 42.4 point 4).
DEC-0155 (committed refused sign-ins, per-account lockout over HTTP) is kept by owner decision (DEC-0157).
The country lists start on Canada by owner decision (DEC-0157).
The Customer Account is English only (OD-39, DEC-0154); Vietnamese customer copy is a later pack.
Audit access shows old and new values only for an approved change request (DEC-0148).
Registration, verification, password reset, lockout, session revocation and refused sign-ins still read 'system' as actor (DEC-0153).
A linked customer's email cannot be changed by staff while its account is active or suspended; the account must be deactivated first (DEC-0142). Customers cannot change their own (DEC-0125).
A takeover sends no message to the deactivated account's former holder, by owner decision (DEC-0144).
No shipment email exists; when built it must not read contact_suppressions (DEC-0143), which test_uat_round_7.py checks structurally.
Evidence references may still contain a typed name; the field now asks for none (DEC-0141) and the display refuses values containing @.
The profile screen is audited at desktop width only.
Public tracking shows only published milestones (DEC-0118).
Two moderate npm audit findings remain on react-router 6.30.6; neither is reachable in this application (dependency_audit.residual_findings).
eslint 9.39.5 is marked unsupported on the registry; development tooling only.
The unexplained intermittent blank page (blank_page_observation) is still not classified as fixed.
The nine launch blockers in unresolved_launch_blockers are unchanged; none is a development task.
The CA-SEC-07 browser-history residual is accepted by the owner (DEC-0122).
Two backend tests need the main checkout's gitignored databases and fail in a worktree; to be confirmed green there before merge (section 42.2).
